summary_rationale: Apple operates an unmatched consumer hardware-software-services ecosystem spanning over 2.5 billion active devices and 1.5 billion paid subscriptions, generating $478.83 billion in FY2026 revenue, 48.8% gross margin, 71.95% ROIC, and $136.06 billion in free cash flow via a negative 66-day cash conversion cycle. Business quality is unambiguously COMPOUNDER_PASS, while KPI health carries a PASS_WITH_WATCH flag for Q1 FY2027 gross margin compression guidance (45%-46% on memory inflation and AI compute costs), U.S. DOJ and EU DMA regulatory remedies targeting App Store take rates and Google search licensing, and execution on the delayed Siri AI and Vision Pro pivots.
